title: More Crafting Recipes
description: This mod introduces new crafting recipes for some of Items, Blocks etc!
body:
**More Crafting Recipes** is a mod that adds crafting recipes for several uncraftable items in **Minecraft 1.21.4**, allowing players to craft unique blocks and items directly from the crafting table or inventory. This mod enhances gameplay by giving you more control over obtaining rare and essential survival tools without relying on mob drops, chests, or else.

**✅ Added Items / Blocks (Craftable Now!)**:
- Nether Star
- End Portal Frame
- Beehive
- Bee Nest
- Sculk Sensor
- Sculk Catalyst
- Iron Horse Armor
- Diamond Horse Armor
- Name Tag
- Saddle
- Blaze Rod
- Enchanted Golden Apple
- Netherite Upgrade
- Sculk Shrieker
- Bell
